response.justification: Bogdan brings strong full-stack experience across TypeScript, Node.js, React, and cloud tools like AWS CDK, with direct alignment to the required stack and AI-agent work. His extensive open-source contributions, architecture skills, and cross-language proficiency (including Java/Kotlin) are major strengths. Concerns include limited explicit mention of Nest.js, Vitest, or Kubernetes in production contexts, and basic German may hinder collaboration in a Berlin-based team.
strengths: Proven full-stack expertise with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and AWS
Demonstrated AI-agent and agentic workflow experience at re:cinq
Strong open-source contributions and architectural versatility across languages
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest in professional experience
